sources: International Federation of the Red Cross (IFRC)
description: Tanzania: 1,500 displacements (sheltered), 27 December - 31 December. Approximately 1500 people were sheltered due to flood on 27 December in Kilosa, Morogoro, Coastal Zone, Tanzania, according to red cross/red crescent movement. International Federation of the Red Cross (IFRC) - 03 January 2026
